suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as neuromuscular musculoskeletal complication. Require documented cerebral palsy and separately documented scoliosis. Preserve the higher-risk severe/spastic phenotypes described in the source and do not infer scoliosis from CP alone. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of cerebral palsy and Scoliosis
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented cerebral palsy and separately documented scoliosis. Preserve the higher-risk severe/spastic phenotypes described in the source and do not infer scoliosis from CP alone.
